messages.description: Short activity state beside the dot's public progress description in the room header and identity card. Keep select keys unchanged. Working means using a computer; Creating means making an artifact; Payment describes payment-related work, not permission; needsInput means waiting for a real user response; Ready means idle; Paused means paused by the user; Simplify means simplifying something; Blame means tracing responsibility. unnamed is an unnamed placeholder. Translate state labels only, not the separate public progress description.
